summary: Bull Head light on the headland north of Bay Bulls, first lit in 1908; its cast-iron tower is the only part of the station still standing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not reconciled. LHF gives 1906 for the manufacture of the cast-iron tower. The Newfoundland 3D gallery says it was built in 1906; the heritage statement says it was built in 1908 and gives no manufacture date. Story states the disagreement. All agree the light was first lit in 1908.
The Coast Guard list gives a flash every six seconds (Fl W 6s), which the record uses. LHF says every five seconds today. Not resolved; the list is the current authority, so the record stands.

notes_for_editor: Thin station: the history rests on one narrative page (LHF, which cites the Newfoundland Journal of the House of Assembly without pages). Story shape is thin (no headings, about 400 words) because there is one history source. The Journal is not in the corpus, so the keeper names are unverified beyond LHF; none were matched by position. The corpus (Canadian Marine reports to 1924, Lighthouse Board, Commissioner, LSS) holds no Bay Bulls entry, since the station was a Newfoundland light until 1949. Chronicling America was not searched for this station. The 1920 royal commission is known only through LHF's quotations; the commission report was not read. The Register entry (historicplaces 9729) and the Parks Canada DFHD page (id 4000, script-rendered, no text through fetch_text) are not cited. The 1969 contract keeper is named in LHF; the story omits the name because the man's connection ended after 1960 and no public role is named beyond the contract. The 1920 fog-alarm recommendation is not in the story, since LHF does not say whether it was installed; the evidence entry is kept for the record. Height and focal-height values differ across sources (see corrections). Focal height: the Coast Guard list gives 60.0 m for the focal height and LHF gives a focal plane of 62.5 m; the record keeps the list's 60 m, and the story does not give a focal height. Fact-check 2026-10-27: every quote found on the first run; story reworded where it followed LHF too closely, the 1906/1908 building dates now stated as a disagreement, and 'known locally' (no source) removed.
